headlines.title: Optics Stocks Drop on Anthropic News, WSJ Report: Lumentum Down 10%, Corning Down 8%, AXT Down 12%
headlines.summary: A risk-off wave is hammering optics stocks at midday Tuesday, and the triggers go well beyond anything that changed in the optics sector itself. Two separate headlines about AI spending have investors scrambling to reprice names that already carry enormous year-to-date gains.

headlines.title: Lumentum (LITE) Stock Looks Fully Priced Despite Cash Flow Upside
headlines.summary: Lumentum Holdings has turned into a very strong performer over the past few years, yet its valuation checks are split, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate pointing to meaningful upside while market multiples paint a more demanding picture. After a very large three year return and sharp recent gains, the stock now sits at the center of a pricing debate rather than a clear bargain or clear bubble.

headlines.title: Lumentum Holdings Stock: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
headlines.summary: Lumentum Holdings has significantly outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

headlines.title: AXT Soars Again on Monday to Lead Optics Stocks. Coherent and Lumentum Rally on Indium Phosphide Price Hikes
headlines.summary: A Taipei supply report on indium phosphide just sent shockwaves through the optics sector, and the institutional money that quietly positioned ahead of Monday's session suggests this squeeze may have much further to run.

headlines.title: 24/7 Wall St.’s Lumentum Recommendation is Up More than 1000%. Here’s Why the Stock Can Keep Rallying.
headlines.summary: Lumentum's fiscal Q4 earnings triggered a 5% selloff before a stunning reversal sent shares surging 14% the next day. Here is what the conference call revealed that completely flipped market sentiment and why analysts believe the biggest growth catalysts have not even arrived yet.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Cloud & Networking and Industrial Tech. The Cloud & Networking segment offers optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems supplied to cloud data center operators, AI/ML infrastructure providers, and network equipment manufacturer customers that are building cloud data centers and network infrastructures. Its Industrial Tech segment provides short-pulse solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers that serves the semiconductor device, solar cell, display, and electric vehicle and battery manufacturing markets. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
